Analyze this document or image (which may be a PDF or photo).

1. Identify the document type strictly as one of:
   - "Visiting Card"
   - "PAN Card"
   - "Aadhaar Card"
   - "Driving License"
   - "Unknown"

2. Extract all available information into a structured JSON format.

Return strictly a valid JSON object matching this schema with no Markdown code block wrappers:
{
  "docType": "Visiting Card | PAN Card | Aadhaar Card | Driving License | Unknown",
  "data": {
    "name": "Full name or empty string",
    "title_designation": "Job title (if visiting card)",
    "company": "Company/Organization name (if visiting card)",
    "phone": "Phone number or empty string",
    "email": "Email address or empty string",
    "website": "Website URL or empty string",
    "address": "Full address or empty string",
    "id_number": "ID number / License number / Card number (if applicable)",
    "dob": "Date of birth (if applicable)",
    "father_name": "Father's name (if applicable)"
  }
}
